evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Retire inactive draft PRs to reduce clutter and triage burden.
intent.acceptance: Independently verified source-eligible inactive draft PR closures. Historical draft state, actual inactivity and exemption state, and open-to-closed-unmerged transition are required independently of the cleanup comment.

evidence.opportunity: Bounded discovery-selected public output entities, not an eligible-opportunity census.
evidence.collection: Digest-checked retained provider originals; independent event replay and historical graph reconciliation; no network, Git, target execution or model calls.

model.architecture: Source-native deterministic lifecycle/graph oracle, separate acquisition, standard schema-3 collection and reporting.
model.recommendation: Not rated: no agreed keep bar. Partial native subtotals are not complete periods or causal evidence.

metrics.name: verified inactive drafts retired
metrics.formula: Count unique independently verified source-eligible closures delivered in [start,end); null without native evidence.

metrics.name: Receipt-linked closures
metrics.formula: Subset of native closures joined to actual source/runtime/application receipts; null without those receipts.

metrics.name: Full goal completion
metrics.formula: Null until all original acceptance and safeguards, complete eligible population and historical state are established.

definition.originalAcceptance: An open draft with no keep-draft, blocked or awaiting-review label and at least 14 days since ALL relevant activity is closed unmerged after warning, retaining stale-draft and a helpful closure comment. Activity includes commits, comments, label changes, review requests/reviews and title/body updates.
definition.safeguards: Warning timing, complete communication, draft-rate goal, full opportunity coverage and subsequent reopens remain separately assessed.
limitations: Retrospective source-history-informed bounded assessment, not complete eligible-population coverage.
Only sub-issue-closer currently has real native acceptance evidence. Neither PR cleanup instrument is qualified as measured completion.
Full goal acceptance, keep/change verdict and costs remain unmeasured. Original stricter contracts are preserved.
